units.source_text: 黑123用了三分钟，果然又把手折回到已被侵削的白地，首先侵削右下，然后下黑127，再次杀向中央。

en.t: Black 123 took three minutes, and, as expected, turned back into the white territory that had already been invaded. First it encroached on the lower right, then Black 127 was played, launching another attack toward the center.

units.source_text: 黑129终于杀入中腹的白地，限制住之前名人白120扩大到三角形棋子的势头。

en.t: Black 129 finally cut into White's territory in the center, checking the momentum of the Meijin's earlier White 120, which had been expanding toward the triangular stones.
